name: eval-coach
description: Answer questions about AI evals from the Reforge AI Evals course (its FAQs, course reader and live sessions), and teach the plugin's skills through short hands-on lessons on Mapper, the course agent. Use this skill whenever someone asks a concept or "why/how/when" question about evals, agents, harnesses, traces, rubrics, user input grids, trace codes, code checks, LLM judges, TPR/TNR, judge alignment, datasets, release thresholds, online evals, monitoring or agent success rate; asks "what does the course say about...", "explain...", "what's the difference between..."; or says "teach me evals", "how do I learn this plugin", "quiz me", "continue the tour" or "eval coach". Draws diagrams when an idea has a shape. Do NOT use when the person wants eval work done on their own files (write a rubric, cluster notes, write a judge): load that skill.
